projects.title: YouTube Video RAG Chatbot
projects.problem: Extracting key insights or getting specific answers from long video lectures and tutorials is time-consuming and inefficient.
projects.solution: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based Question Answering system that extracts YouTube transcripts, creates vector indices, and feeds relevant video context to Google's Gemini model to produce highly accurate, context-bound responses.
workflow: Engineered a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using LangChain, FAISS, HuggingFace Embeddings, and Gemini AI to support context-aware question answering.
Performed data collection and preprocessing of YouTube transcripts, generating vector embeddings and implementing semantic search for accurate information retrieval.
Integrated retrieval and LLM-based generation techniques to deliver reliable, context-relevant responses, improving insight extraction from unstructured data.
features: Direct transcript download using only a YouTube Video ID.
Dense vector semantic search capable of handling conceptual questions.
Modular chain pipeline using LangChain and FAISS vector indexing.
challenges: Handling transcripts with variable formatting and multi-speaker segments.
Tuning chunk size and embeddings to balance context recall with latency.
futureImprovements: Adding interactive UI with source timestamp citations.
Multi-turn conversation memory for continuous Q&A.

projects.title: Movie Recommendation System
projects.problem: With thousands of movies available online, users struggle to find relevant titles that match their specific tastes, leading to choice paralysis.
projects.solution: Built a content-based machine learning recommendation model using cosine similarity and feature engineering on the TMDb movie dataset, deployed via an interactive Streamlit UI.
workflow: Built a content-based machine learning recommendation model using cosine similarity and feature engineering on the TMDb movie dataset.
Conducted exploratory data analysis (EDA) and data cleaning on movie metadata to identify patterns and improve recommendation accuracy.
Developed an interactive Streamlit application integrated with the TMDb API for dynamic data retrieval and presentation.
features: Interactive movie selection interface with instant similarity ranking.
Dynamic poster visualization using live TMDb API queries.
Robust data cleaning and metadata preprocessing pipeline.
Fast content-based matching using cosine similarity.
challenges: Handling nested, dirty, string-formatted JSON data inside TMDB columns.
Optimizing similarity computation across large feature matrices.
futureImprovements: Hybrid recommendation combining content-based and collaborative filtering.
User rating feedback loop for personalized score adjustments.
